# Frequently Asked Questions (website)
Which Earthora moringa products are available?
Our live product collection shows the moringa products currently available, with their ingredients, prices, stock and directions. Please check the product page for the latest details before ordering.
What is the recommended daily dosage for Morilife+ Moringa Leaf Tablets?
The approved tablet label says to take 1–2 tablets once or twice daily, before breakfast or dinner. Follow the product label and ask a healthcare professional if you need individual advice.
Do your pressed tablets contain synthetic binders or magnesium stearate?
Please check the current product label for the complete ingredient list. If you need to avoid a particular binder or additive, contact our team to confirm before ordering.
How should I store Earthora Moringa products to maintain freshness?
Follow the storage instructions on your product packaging. Keep the container closed and protect it from heat, moisture and direct sunlight.
How long before I start feeling the health benefits of Moringa?
Experiences vary from person to person, so we cannot promise a time frame or specific health result. Please speak with a healthcare professional about individual health questions.
Does Earthora Moringa contain caffeine?
No! Moringa is naturally 100% caffeine-free. Its natural energy boost comes from high cellular bioavailability of Iron, B-complex vitamins, Magnesium, and essential amino acids that support natural ATP synthesis without jitters or crashes.
Is Earthora Moringa safe during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
Please consult your healthcare practitioner before taking a moringa supplement during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Do you offer free shipping across India?
Our Shipping Policy lists free standard shipping on prepaid orders across India. Check your checkout summary for the delivery terms on your order.
How fast will my order arrive?
All orders are shipped via India Post and delivered across Pan-India within 7–14 business days.
Do you ship internationally?
We currently only ship within India. International shipping is not available yet. Stay tuned for updates!
What payment methods do you accept?
We accept all major Credit/Debit Cards, UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), NetBanking, and Razorpay Payment Links across India.
Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
Once an order is placed, it cannot be modified or cancelled. If you have any concerns, please email us at earthorafarms@gmail.com and our team will do their best to assist you.

# Privacy Policy (website)
Data Protection & Privacy
Your privacy is our sacred trust.
Learn how Earthora Farms collects, protects, and handles your personal information across our website and logistics.
Effective Date: July 29, 2026 Version 1.2
1. Information We Collect
At Earthora Farms Pvt. Ltd., we respect your personal data. We collect information you provide directly to us when making purchases or subscribing to newsletters:
Contact Details: Full name, delivery address, phone number, email address, and 6-digit PIN code.
Transaction History: Order details, Razorpay payment link statuses, and delivery confirmations. We do NOT store credit card numbers directly.
2. How We Use Your Data
Your data is used to provide and support your shopping experience:
Fulfilling and delivering orders for products listed in our live collection via courier partners.
Sending order confirmation SMS, WhatsApp payment links, and dispatch tracking alerts via Tata SmartFlow.
Preventing fraudulent transactions and ensuring network security.
3. Data Protection & Sharing
We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third-party marketers. We only share relevant details with trusted service infrastructure partners:
Payment Gateways: Razorpay Software Private Limited for secure checkout processing.
Telephony & SMS: Tata Communications (SmartFlo/SmartFlow) for call routing and SMS/WhatsApp link dispatch.
Logistics Partners: BlueDart, Delhivery, and FedEx for order transit.
4. Your Rights & Data Deletion
You hold full control over your personal records. You may request to review, update, or permanently delete your account details and call history by contacting our Data Protection Officer at privacy@earthorafarms.com .
